## Install

This is the launcher for KSP Retooled. It allows you to install retooled into an existing KSP install. You will need a stock install of KSP 1.12.5.

There are different version of the launcher available depending on your OS. Download the one that matches your OS below. If you would rather not run an installer, the portable zip holds the whole launcher: extract it anywhere and start `KSP Retooled Launcher`.

On macOS, open the disk image and drag *KSP Retooled Launcher* to Applications. Started from the disk image itself, it can't update itself.

| System | File |
| ------ | ---- |
| Windows               | [`KSPRetooled.Launcher-windows-x64-Setup.exe`]({{DOWNLOAD_URL}}/KSPRetooled.Launcher-windows-x64-Setup.exe) |
| Linux                 | [`KSPRetooled.Launcher-linux-x64.AppImage`]({{DOWNLOAD_URL}}/KSPRetooled.Launcher-linux-x64.AppImage) |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | [`KSPRetooled.Launcher-macos-arm64.dmg`]({{DOWNLOAD_URL}}/KSPRetooled.Launcher-macos-arm64.dmg) |
| macOS (Intel)         | [`KSPRetooled.Launcher-macos-x64.dmg`]({{DOWNLOAD_URL}}/KSPRetooled.Launcher-macos-x64.dmg) |

| System | Portable zip |
| ------ | ------------ |
| Windows               | [`KSPRetooled.Launcher-windows-x64-Portable.zip`]({{DOWNLOAD_URL}}/KSPRetooled.Launcher-windows-x64-Portable.zip) |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | [`KSPRetooled.Launcher-macos-arm64-Portable.zip`]({{DOWNLOAD_URL}}/KSPRetooled.Launcher-macos-arm64-Portable.zip) |
| macOS (Intel)         | [`KSPRetooled.Launcher-macos-x64-Portable.zip`]({{DOWNLOAD_URL}}/KSPRetooled.Launcher-macos-x64-Portable.zip) |

## Uninstall

To return KSP to stock, click **Uninstall** in the launcher before you remove the launcher itself. Removing the launcher leaves the game as it is.

- **Windows:** open Settings → Apps → Installed apps, find *KSP Retooled Launcher* and choose Uninstall.
- **macOS:** move *KSP Retooled Launcher* from Applications to the Trash. Its settings are in `~/Library/Application Support/KSPRetooled`.
- **Linux:** delete the AppImage. Its settings are in `~/.local/share/KSPRetooled`.
- **Portable zip:** delete the folder you extracted it to.
